summary: Integrations Tab/Vault feature tested successfully. Backend API (14/14 tests passed) and frontend UI fully functional. Password-protected vault shows 17 integrations across 6 categories with correct data.
critical_code_review_comments: Integrations Tab properly implemented with password protection (sha256 hash of 'Blh9170873')
All 17 integrations present with correct structure: id, name, status, details, dashboard_url
Sensitive data properly masked with mask() function (first 8 chars + '...' + last 4 chars)
Status badges correctly show: active (green), blocked (amber - Twilio), free/self-hosted (blue)
Show/Hide credentials toggle works correctly for cards with sensitive data
Lock button properly re-locks vault by resetting state
require_founder() check ensures only admin users can access endpoint (403 for others)
IntegrationsTab component has proper data-testid attributes for testing

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All UI elements and interactions verified

context_for_next_testing_agent: Integrations Tab/Vault feature complete. Backend endpoint: POST /api/admin/integrations/unlock accepts {password: string} and returns {integrations: array[17]}. Frontend IntegrationsTab component at /admin/integrations shows password lock screen until correct password entered. 17 integrations in 6 categories: Infrastructure (railway, vercel, mongodb, s3), Payments & Subscriptions (stripe, apple_iap), AI & Communication (xai, resend, twilio), Native & Updates (capgo, capacitor, google_places), Security & Auth (webauthn, vapid, jwt), Local Processing (voice_biometrics, pdf_tools). Each card shows name, status badge, details grid, dashboard link, and show/hide credentials toggle for sensitive data. Lock button re-locks vault.

backend_apis: Wrong password returns 403 with 'Invalid password' detail
frontend_components: Integrations tab appears in admin tab bar (scroll right to find it, data-testid='admin-tab-integrations')
Navigating to /admin/integrations shows password lock screen
Wrong password shows 'Incorrect password' error message
Correct password unlocks vault and shows all 17 integrations
Integration cards display: name, status badge, details grid, dashboard links
Show/Hide credentials toggle (data-testid='reveal-{id}') works for sensitive data
Lock button (data-testid='integrations-lock-btn') re-locks vault and shows password screen
